filterSummary: Successfully curated 10 highly relevant videos across 5 complex distributed database topics. For English, selections prioritized high-reach, university-level lectures. For Arabic, while some topics had abundant high-view content, Query Processing and Transparency required utilizing the best available candidates above 500 views to ensure complete and accurate coverage.
